Ava (Product Design): Hey team — quick design review: the relevance table colors feel pretty noisy when scanning large batches. Thinking we should soften the high/medium/low color stops and add a stronger keyboard focus state. Screenshot: https://redwood.ai/s/shot123 :eyes:
Leo (Frontend Eng): Totally. Current red/green clashes with status chips. My quick idea: mute the extremes, e.g. use softer fills and keep a solid border for high. Also bump focus ring to 3px and use a higher-contrast outline color. I can prototype CSS tonight. :+1:
Maya (Accessibility): Important note: color alone can't be the only signal — we need text labels and aria attributes. Suggest adding an offscreen label like "High relevance" and a visible text fallback for small screens. Also verify contrast >= 4.5:1 for chip text.
Sam (Product): Small copy tweak: change header from "Relevance" to "Predicted relevance" and tooltip text -> "Model confidence score (higher = more relevant)." Keeps expectations clear.
Ava (Product Design): Good call on copy, Sam. Also for the batch vectors preview (compact rows) density feels tight — propose a compact/comfortable toggle in the toolbar so users can switch row padding.
Harper (Design Intern): Tried a tiny visual adjustment. CSS snippet I tested in storybook:
```css
.relevance-chip { padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFF, #F6F6F6); color: #1B1F23; }
.row:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(2,120,215,0.9); outline-offset: 2px; }
```
Leo (Frontend Eng): Nice! For compact mode I think we should keep a micro-indicator (dot + tooltip) instead of full mini-graph so scanning speed stays high. When expanded, show the vector preview and scatter mini-graph. Also adding `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` on the row toggle so screen readers announce state.
Maya (Accessibility): Agree. Also keyboard flow: when a row expands with the right-arrow or Enter, focus must land on the first interactive control inside the panel (not just stay on the row). Add `role=button` + `tabindex=0` semantics on the toggle. We'll run with axe and a NVDA walkthrough after the prototype.
Sam (Product): Confirming copy change for tooltip — I'll update the content docs and translations. Also +1 on compact/comfortable toggle. Can we make the default = comfortable for new users and remember preference?
Ava (Product Design): Love the direction. Leo — can you mock up the soft colors + focus ring + compact toggle? Maya — we'll run the contrast checks and a quick a11y session with 3 testers. Sam — once copy is updated we'll roll the tooltip change. Plan to ship as an experimental flag behind "relevance-v2".
Leo (Frontend Eng): Will prototype and open PR from `design/relevance-a11y`. ETA: EOD. Adding checklist in PR: color tokens, focus state, aria labels, keyboard expand behavior, compact toggle state.
deploy-bot: Preview build available at https://staging.redwood.ai/builds/rel-1958765432 — includes prototype branch screenshot and storybook entries.
Ava (Product Design): Great — thanks everyone. Quick follow-up in the morning: can Harper add a compact mock to the design file? :sparkles:
